sara: Ran into a flake in the nightly kv canary. Repro steps below and a tiny log snippet. Seems like snapshot commit + compaction finalization are racing and we briefly serve a stale residency. Anyone seen this pattern?

sara: Repro (kv-canary-2026-03-22): 4 tenants synthetic hot prefixes, force background compaction when slab util >75%, concurrently trigger snapshot on same slab. Failure ~1/20 runs.

sara: Log snippet: ```
[2026-03-22T03:01:10Z] snapshot: begin slab=91 epoch=1902
[2026-03-22T03:01:10Z] compaction: start slab=91 worker=2
[2026-03-22T03:01:10Z] snapshot: commit slab=91 epoch=1902 -> residency=HOT
[2026-03-22T03:01:10Z] compaction: apply tombstones slab=91 -> residency=STALE
```

dan: That ordering implies reads can observe residency change after snapshot commit but before compaction has fully quiesced. Do we have any fencing on the compaction side?

leo: Historically we relied on an epoch publish barrier during snapshot commit that readers check. If compaction mutates after publish but before residency flag flip, race appears. We don't currently emit enough trace events to see exact interleaving.

maya: Minimal plan: 1) add a compact handshake trace event at compaction finalization, 2) add snapshot handshake event at commit, 3) add counter metric compact_snapshot_overlap. Keep events small to avoid perf hit.

leo: Proposed trace payload (one line JSON): `kv_trace("hs", "phase":"snapshot_commit","slab":id,"epoch":e,"seq":s)` and `kv_trace("hs", "phase":"compaction_finish","slab":id,"epoch":e,"seq":s2)`. That lets replay tool order them.

dan: For canary, add a config flag compaction_quiesce_on_snapshot=true to force compaction to wait for snapshot epoch fence. Make it default-off and enable in canary runs.

maya: Agree. Also add a local unit test: simulate snapshot commit, compaction apply with artificial yields to assert no stale read between events.

leo: Also metric: handshake_misorder_total++ when we detect snapshot_commit followed by compaction_finish that reverts residency within same epoch. We can alert if >0 in prod.

ops-bot: Canary job started: kv-canary-2026-03-22 run=83 at 6622334601.

sara: I'll push a small PR that: a) emits handshake traces, b) exposes canary knob, c) increments compact_snapshot_overlap metric. PR owners: tracing/leo, canary/dan, tests/maya.

dan: If traces confirm race, we have two remediation paths: short-term quiesce compaction finalization (safe but could add pause), long-term ensure residency flip is atomic with snapshot commit (harder refactor).

maya: For postmortem ease, I can build a tiny replay that groups handshake events by slab and prints a timeline. If we get >2 failures in the canary we dump full traces and run replay automatically.

leo: One more thought: add an invariant assertion in debug builds: after snapshot commit mark, ensure any compaction applying tombstones increments an in-memory guard token; if token present, compaction finalization must wait. Cheap in debug mode.

ops-bot: Canary progress update: 15/50 iterations completed at 6622334610.

sara: Thanks. If we get a repro with traces I'll attach trace id here and open a short-lived incident for urgent mitigation.

leo: Filing RFC follow-up to propose long-term API: atomic snapshot commit that includes residency delta. Will reference this thread.

sara: TL;DR action items: leo -> handshake traces + metric + small invariant in debug builds; dan -> canary knob + enable in canary; maya -> unit test + replay tool; sara -> run canary + collect traces + open RFC follow-up when data in.

sara: Got them. I'll triage next and loop infra if we need emergency rollback.
